heading: You've been asked to help
body: Create an account, or sign in, to help let people know.
unusableBody: Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
conflictBody: You already have people you're helping, so this invitation can't be joined from this account.
offlineHeading: You need a connection to join
offlineBody: Your link is saved. Open the app again when you're connected.
laterBody: Your link is saved. Open the app again in a little while to try again.
